auftrag: Read the timetable, the announcements and the diary. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: 09:42 – platform 4 – arrives 10:58 – stops at Gatwick Airport
Because of a signal problem, the nine forty-two to Brighton now leaves from platform 6, not from platform 4.
The train will be fifteen minutes late.
Passengers for Gatwick Airport should change at East Croydon.
Please keep your bags with you at all times.
We came to the station at half past nine and bought two tickets.
I did not tell anybody which train we planned to take, except Mr Hale.
We ran to platform 6 and jumped on the train just before the doors closed.
Pidge sat on my bag all the way, and I kept watching the other passengers.

raetsel.frage: Why does the train leave from a different platform?
optionen: There is a problem with the signals.
raetsel.hilfe2: The reason is in the first sentence of the announcement.

raetsel.frage: When will the train arrive in Brighton?
raetsel.hilfe1: The train arrives at 10:58, but it is late.

raetsel.frage: Why does Agent Wren mention Mr Hale in her diary?
optionen: Only he knew about the train, so she wonders about him.
Mr Hale is the driver of the train.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the second sentence of the diary.
raetsel.hilfe2: If only one person knew something, you can ask: Who told others?

raetsel.frage: Put the events in the right order. What happened first?
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the diary from top to bottom.
raetsel.hilfe2: The announcement comes after the waiting and before the running.

raetsel.frage: Agent Wren wrote a short note on the train. It has five mistakes. Can you find them?
raetsel.text: We [[goes|go|going]] to Brighton by train. The train [[leave|leaves|leaving]] at nine forty-two, but it is fifteen minutes late. Pidge [[sit|sits|sitting]] on my bag, and Mr Hale [[nows|knows|know]] the [[plann|plan|plans]].
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the verbs and at the spelling.
raetsel.hilfe2: Every verb that goes with one person or thing needs an -s. Check the nouns too.
